verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its own JMAP API, with a session endpoint at api.fastmail.com/jmap/session and API-token or OAuth auth, and JMAP calls can query, fetch and send mail. That gives a self-built agent a documented connection for reading and sending. There is no evidence of a first-party connector for Claude or ChatGPT, and the pack does not show drafting or triage operations, so an agent must be wired to raw JMAP. Missing for 10: official Claude/ChatGPT/MCP connector, explicit evidence of draft and triage (move/flag/label) operations, hands-on corroboration of agent use end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
Standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens. No custom auth protocol to implement.
